mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% for three consecutive months signals a monetary easing cycle that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, thereby increasing the present value of future dividends and earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
